// src/command-line-text-extractor.ts
import type { Conversion, TextExtractor } from "@family-agenda/application";
import type { OcrLanguage } from "@family-agenda/domain";
export type CommandLineTextExtractorOptions = {
    timeoutMs?: number;
    tessdataDirectory?: string;
};
export declare class CommandLineTextExtractor implements TextExtractor {
    private readonly timeoutMs;
    private readonly tessdataDirectory;
    constructor(options?: CommandLineTextExtractorOptions);
    textLayer(pdf: Uint8Array): Promise<Conversion<string[]>>;
    ocr(pdf: Uint8Array, pages: number[], languages: OcrLanguage[]): Promise<Conversion<string[]>>;
    private render;
    private tool;
    private withPdf;
}

// src/oidc-identity-provider-client.ts
import type { IdentityProviderClient, IdentityProviderConnection, PendingSignIn, VerifiedIdentity } from "@family-agenda/application";
export declare class OidcIdentityProviderClient implements IdentityProviderClient {
    discover(issuerUrl: string): Promise<{
        ok: true;
    } | {
        ok: false;
        message: string;
    }>;
    begin(connection: IdentityProviderConnection, redirectUri: string): Promise<{
        authorizationUrl: string;
        pending: PendingSignIn;
    }>;
    complete(connection: IdentityProviderConnection, _redirectUri: string, callbackUrl: string, pending: PendingSignIn): Promise<VerifiedIdentity | null>;
}
// src/openai-compatible-extractor.ts
import type { EndpointHealth, ExtractionRequest, ExtractionResult, Extractor, LlmEndpoint } from "@family-agenda/application";
export type OpenAiCompatibleExtractorOptions = {
    timeoutMs?: number;
};
export declare const extractionSchema: {
    type: string;
    additionalProperties: boolean;
    required: string[];
    properties: {
        events: {
            type: string;
            items: {
                type: string;
                additionalProperties: boolean;
                required: string[];
                properties: {
                    title: {
                        type: string[];
                    };
                    date: {
                        type: string;
                        additionalProperties: boolean;
                        required: string[];
                        properties: {
                            day: {
                                type: string[];
                            };
                            month: {
                                type: string[];
                            };
                            year: {
                                type: string[];
                            };
                            weekday: {
                                type: string[];
                                enum: ("monday" | "tuesday" | "wednesday" | "thursday" | "friday" | "saturday" | "sunday" | null)[];
                            };
                            daysAfter: {
                                type: string[];
                            };
                            weeksAfter: {
                                type: string[];
                            };
                        };
                    };
                    startTime: {
                        type: string[];
                    };
                    endTime: {
                        type: string[];
                    };
                    place: {
                        type: string[];
                    };
                    evidence: {
                        type: string;
                    };
                };
            };
        };
        tasks: {
            type: string;
            items: {
                type: string;
                additionalProperties: boolean;
                required: string[];
                properties: {
                    title: {
                        type: string[];
                    };
                    deadline: {
                        type: string;
                        additionalProperties: boolean;
                        required: string[];
                        properties: {
                            day: {
                                type: string[];
                            };
                            month: {
                                type: string[];
                            };
                            year: {
                                type: string[];
                            };
                            weekday: {
                                type: string[];
                                enum: ("monday" | "tuesday" | "wednesday" | "thursday" | "friday" | "saturday" | "sunday" | null)[];
                            };
                            daysAfter: {
                                type: string[];
                            };
                            weeksAfter: {
                                type: string[];
                            };
                        };
                    };
                    bring: {
                        type: string;
                        items: {
                            type: string;
                        };
                    };
                    evidence: {
                        type: string;
                    };
                };
            };
        };
    };
};
export declare class OpenAiCompatibleExtractor implements Extractor {
    private readonly timeoutMs;
    constructor(options?: OpenAiCompatibleExtractorOptions);
    extract(request: ExtractionRequest): Promise<ExtractionResult>;
    health(endpoint: LlmEndpoint): Promise<EndpointHealth>;
    models(endpoint: LlmEndpoint): Promise<string[]>;
    private listModels;
    private complete;
}
// src/postgres/database.ts
import type { PgDatabase, PgQueryResultHKT } from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";
import * as schema from "./schema";
export type Database = PgDatabase<PgQueryResultHKT, typeof schema>;
export type PostgresConnection = {
    db: Database;
    migrate(): Promise<void>;
    close(): Promise<void>;
};
export declare const migrationsFolder: string;
export { schema as postgresSchema };
export type PostgresPoolOptions = {
    max?: number;
    idleTimeoutMillis?: number;
};
export declare function connectPostgres(databaseUrl: string, options?: PostgresPoolOptions): PostgresConnection;
export declare function runMigrations(connection: PostgresConnection): Promise<void>;
// src/postgres/migration-history.ts
import { type SQL } from "drizzle-orm";
type Queryable = {
    execute(query: SQL): PromiseLike<unknown>;
};
export declare class OldMigrationHistoryError extends Error {
    constructor();
}
export declare class NewerMigrationHistoryError extends Error {
    constructor(applied: number, known: number);
}
export declare function refuseOldMigrationHistory(db: Queryable, migrationsFolder: string): Promise<void>;
export declare function refuseNewerMigrationHistory(db: Queryable, migrationsFolder: string): Promise<void>;
export {};
// src/postgres/envelope-secret-store.ts
import type { SecretRef, SecretStore } from "@family-agenda/application";
import type { Database } from "./database";
export declare class EnvelopeSecretStore implements SecretStore {
    private readonly db;
    private readonly masterKey;
    constructor(db: Database, masterKey: Buffer);
    put(plaintext: string): Promise<SecretRef>;
    get(ref: SecretRef): Promise<string | null>;
    remove(ref: SecretRef): Promise<void>;
    list(): Promise<{
        ref: SecretRef;
        storedAt: Date;
    }[]>;
}
// src/postgres/repositories.ts

}

    findByEmail(email: Email): Promise<Admin | null>;

}

}

export declare class PostgresSourceRepository implements SourceRepository {
    private readonly db;
    constructor(db: Database);

    migrateConfig(id: SourceId, fromVersion: number, plain: PlainConfig, configVersion: number): Promise<void>;
    update(source: Source): Promise<void>;
    recordFailedRun(id: SourceId, at: Date, error: RunError): Promise<void>;
    recordFailedExtraction(id: SourceId, at: Date): Promise<void>;
    setShown(id: SourceId, shown: boolean): Promise<void>;
    rename(id: SourceId, name: string | null): Promise<void>;
    declareAttributes(id: SourceId, attributes: DeclaredAttribute[]): Promise<void>;
    archiveAttribute(id: SourceId, externalId: string): Promise<void>;
    assignAttribute(id: SourceAttributeId, concerns: FamilyMemberId[]): Promise<boolean>;
    remove(id: SourceId): Promise<BlobRef[]>;
    private select;
    private attributesOf;
}

// src/postgres/item-repository.ts
import type { Extraction, ItemRepository, PendingMessage, ProjectedItem, RawMessage, ReadStated, RunRecorded, SourceRun } from "@family-agenda/application";
import type { BlobRef, ItemId, RawMessageId, SourceId } from "@family-agenda/domain";
import type { Database } from "./database";
export declare class PostgresItemRepository implements ItemRepository {
    private readonly db;
    constructor(db: Database);
    recordRun(run: SourceRun, read: ReadStated): Promise<RunRecorded>;
    private withdraw;
    purgeMessages(now: Date, retainedSince: Date): Promise<{
        files: BlobRef[];
        purged: number;
        deleted: number;
    }>;
    pendingExtractionFailures(): Promise<(Date | null)[]>;
    pendingMessages(limit: number, failedAfter: Date): Promise<PendingMessage[]>;
    pendingMessageCount(scope: {
        sourceId?: SourceId;
    }): Promise<number>;
    recordExtraction(extraction: Extraction): Promise<void>;
    findMessage(id: RawMessageId): Promise<RawMessage | null>;
    itemsOfMessage(id: RawMessageId): Promise<ProjectedItem[]>;
    overlapping(from: Date, to: Date | null): Promise<ProjectedItem[]>;
    outstanding(): Promise<ProjectedItem[]>;
    find(id: ItemId): Promise<ProjectedItem | null>;
    setTaskDone(id: ItemId, at: Date | null): Promise<void>;
    remove(id: ItemId): Promise<boolean>;
    private query;
    private projected;
}

// src/tessdata-directory.ts
import type { Conversion, OcrModel, OcrModelStore } from "@family-agenda/application";
import { type OcrLanguage } from "@family-agenda/domain";
export type TessdataCatalog = {
    checksums: ReadonlyMap<string, string>;
    download(language: OcrLanguage): Promise<Uint8Array>;
};
export type TessdataDirectoryOptions = {
    directory: string;
    bundledDirectory: string | null;
    catalog: TessdataCatalog;
};
export declare class TessdataDirectory implements OcrModelStore {
    private readonly options;
    constructor(options: TessdataDirectoryOptions);
    linkBundled(): Promise<void>;
    private linkFile;
    downloadable(): OcrLanguage[];
    installed(): Promise<OcrModel[]>;
    install(language: OcrLanguage): Promise<Conversion<null>>;
    remove(language: OcrLanguage): Promise<void>;
}
